areas.label: Main Entrance
areas.desc: Main Entrance for the commoners and those travelling by coach

areas.label: Shops
areas.desc: Two circular shops, staffed by friendly seeming shopkeeps and clerks, ready to sell you newspapers, gadgets, souvenirs, Merkavar Bread, Azkataria Tea, Atarialda Cheese, Itsasalda rum, Emarrea Sake or whatever you might need before you go home

areas.label: The Information Board
areas.desc: A Board showing all arrivals on one half and all departures on the other, magically updated, arcanotech driven

areas.label: The Waiting Rooms
areas.desc: Two areas to simply sit and wait, while watching out over the busy Market plaza in front of the train station

areas.label: Staff Office
areas.desc: Three tables for clerks, shelves for books, the place for lost & found

areas.label: Ticket Office
areas.desc: The main Ticket Office for everyone, four clerks work here at rush hour handling customers

areas.label: Post Office Desk
areas.desc: A desk for two clerks of the adventurer guild handling letters and packages

areas.label: Post Office Storage
areas.desc: A room half filled with packages and letter meant for other cities, relatives, friends, businesses

areas.label: Fresh Produce Stand
areas.desc: A shop off to the side, selling local fresh produce and bread, loved by locals, overlooked by tourists.

areas.label: The train tracks
areas.desc: Three train tracks, sometimes filled with waiting trains, sometimes waiting for the next train

areas.label: ViP Entrance
areas.desc: If you've got the money or status this is your entrance, up to four clerks handling important people through their own entrance
